name: COVER Corporation
summary: COVER Corporation operates in three areas: virtual platforms, media ventures and the management of virtual YouTuber (VTuber) talent. Its VTuber Production division acts as an agency creating and overseeing virtual personalities, and its Media Mix efforts extend VTuber IP through merchandise, licensing, collaborations and content. It is also developing Holoearth, a sandbox game. The firm was set up in Tokyo in 2016.
